verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server repository (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), which gives agents a tool-calling surface over Elasticsearch indexes. Official agent skills for the Elastic stack round this out. However, the evidence only shows that the server exists; it does not say which tools it exposes. Missing for 10: documentation of which query, analytics/aggregation and index-management operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use it successfully.
